h1.en: concrete pump split piston φ230 restated in the order of Waveguide flange
h1.zh: 按《Waveguide flange》的次序重述concrete pump split piston φ230

directAnswer.en: concrete pump split piston φ230 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Waveguide flange, and that page is not a second nameplate. A φ230 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. No published pump page assigns φ230 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump split piston φ230下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Waveguide flange》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ230 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ230 指定到某一型号。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Pressurization”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ230 row, materials: rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ230 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ230, the material row (rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Pressurization”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ230 这一行，材料：橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ230 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ230、材料行（橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: The heading “Electrical continuity” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. A φ230 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are rubber, rubber-cloth and polyurethane. No published pump page assigns φ230 to a model. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Electrical continuity”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 φ230 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是橡胶、橡胶夹布和聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ230 指定到某一型号。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Attachment to waveguide”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：Attachment to waveguide”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Standards” does not grade a material and does not assign a machine that the row itself does not name. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 分体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waveguide_flange
body.zh: “标准”不评定材料，也不把目录行没有点名的机器指定过来。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明分体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waveguide_flange
